# HTTMELY

Product: HTTMELY
Category: local-first macOS HTML and Markdown folder reader
Repository: https://github.com/dot-RealityTest/HTMELLY
Landing page: https://dot-realitytest.github.io/HTMELLY/
Download: https://github.com/dot-RealityTest/HTMELLY/releases
License: MIT

Summary: HTTMELY is a native macOS app for opening local folders of HTML and Markdown files in a calm AppKit/WKWebView reader. It saves folder shortcuts as local Places, renders pages with a sidebar and optional contents navigation, and keeps all state on the user's Mac.

Audience: macOS users, developers, writers, researchers, local-first tool builders, and people who generate HTML or Markdown page collections from scripts, notes, exports, logs, or AI-assisted workflows.

Key features:
- Open local .html, .htm, .md, and .markdown folders.
- Save multiple local Places without moving files.
- Browse pages in a native macOS sidebar.
- Show optional in-page contents navigation from headings.
- Open and reveal source files in Finder.
- Rename, reorder, remove, export, or archive local folder shortcuts.
- Store UI state in local user defaults only.
- Generate local report folders as an optional workflow.

Privacy: HTTMELY does not add cloud sync, uploads, analytics, accounts, remote databases, or external services. Generated report data is ignored by the public repository because it can contain private local paths.

Build:
- make run
- make verify
- cd viewer && ./script/package_release.sh

Documentation:
- README: https://github.com/dot-RealityTest/HTMELLY#readme
- User guide: https://dot-realitytest.github.io/HTMELLY/user/GETTING_STARTED.md
- Privacy: https://dot-realitytest.github.io/HTMELLY/user/LOCAL_FIRST_PRIVACY.md
- Overview: https://dot-realitytest.github.io/HTMELLY/overview.md

Keywords: HTTMELY, macOS app, Swift, AppKit, WKWebView, local-first, HTML reader, Markdown reader, folder reader, local documentation, generated reports, offline reader, developer tools, local files.
